The '''Way Of The Wind pt. 1''' is a power [[Books|book]] that can be purchased from the [[Bookseller]] for {{Price|15000}}.

The first reading grants the player a power that gives them a permanent +0.25 {{Name|Speed|class=inline}} buff.<ref name="windpower" /> Once read, it can be found in [[the Player]]'s Menu on the [[Special Items & Powers]] tab. Each subsequent reading gives the player 20 [[Skills|XP]] in each of the 5 skills.

After reading this book for the first time, the player is able to purchase [[Way Of The Wind pt. 2]] from the Bookseller.

==Bundles==
Way Of The Wind pt. 1 is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
Way Of The Wind pt. 1 is not used in any [[tailoring]]. It can be used as an iron [[Dyeing|dye]] when used in the spool of the [[Sewing Machine]] with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
Way Of The Wind pt. 1 is not used in any [[quests]].
